outfitChecklist: Orange, form-fitting tracksuit jacket; black colouring starts at the collar, covers the shoulders and sleeves and runs down the front zip
Black colouring also extends around the waist and across half of the back
White circular design on the left shoulder (no tassel in Part II); red Uzumaki swirl on the back
Plain white T-shirt visible at the neckline
Orange trousers with a shuriken holster on the right knee (he is right-handed)
Long black forehead-protector bandanna with the metal plate at the front
bodyChecklist: Three whisker marks on each cheek
Part II proportions: about 166 cm, lean build
